note: Copied from the app's own data by the Grammar in Action lane (g3). Every record names its source and tests/games.g3.test.js checks the copy against it. Not reviewed by a Hebrew teacher. Verbs whose record says needsReview: false, levels A1 to B1, leaving out any verb with a form spelled like the divine name, words that are crude in slang, and words about death or harm. he is the past (he did); present is the masculine singular.
